    • tinkleBreak

      void tinkleBreak(Character character, ArrayList<Enemy> enemyRoster)
      Forces the user into a bathroom break. This allows enemies to move while the player is stuck, and if the user has consumed more than three potions by this break, they will take ten points of damage
      Parameters:
      character - player character
      enemyRoster - arraylist of enemies in the current dungeon

    • exitRoom

      int exitRoom(RobertCircularlyLinkedList<Room> dungeon, Character character, int levelCount, ArrayList<Enemy> enemyRoster)
      Clears the current dungeon and generates a new one based on the level the player has reached. Enemy health and damage is increased, the player is rewarded with coins for clearing a level.
      Parameters:
      dungeon - the current dungeon being used
      character - player character
      levelCount - current dungeon level
      enemyRoster - arraylist of enemies in the current dungeon
      Returns:
      int value of the current dungeon level
